name: Meese Engine
author: Meese
description_short: Minecraft-inspired open-world voxel game for GameCube.
description_long: Meese Engine is an in-development, Minecraft-inspired open-world voxel game built for the GameCube. Explore a block-based world, place and break blocks, and use the standard GameCube controller to play. This GameCube build is an early indev release rather than a full Minecraft port.

license.notes: The upstream repository and release do not declare a license for Meese Engine.
